quote: In Ontario Canada, fall cover crops of perennial ryegrass (Lolium perenne L.), oat (Avena sativus L.), and red clover (Trifolium pratense L.) reduced residual soil mineral N by 26% to 42% compared to no cover crop after fall-applied liquid swine manure, but the following year maize grain yield was reduced by up to 15% [33].
